description: This file defines a repository interface for client transactions in the Fineract project, using Spring Data JPA. It extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to provide database access methods for ClientTransaction entities, including a custom method to find transactions by external ID.

classes.name: ClientTransactionRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for performing CRUD operations and queries on ClientTransaction entities.

methods.name: findByExternalId
methods.description: Finds a ClientTransaction entity by its ExternalId.
